matches.rationale: Finding 4 identifies that the four-velocity derivation in Eq. (3) incorrectly treats comoving galaxies as acquiring a velocity relative to the observer purely due to metric evolution, when in fact comoving observers share the same frame with zero peculiar velocity — explicitly calling this 'the foundation of the whole paper,' matching the ground truth's claim that the paper wrongly assumes galaxies are in a different reference frame, causing flawed equations throughout.
